rules.rule_context: Controlled Technical Data & Deemed Exports: Any technical data subject to the Export Administration Regulations (EAR), including but not limited to design drawings, specifications, test data, and materials selection criteria bearing a controlled data notice, constitutes controlled technology. Access to such data by any foreign national, whether employed by Henshaw Industrial Supply or a partner entity, regardless of work authorization status or physical location, constitutes a deemed export under 15 CFR 734.14. Authorization from Trade Compliance is required prior to granting access. Non-controlled data, such as general product dimensions or publicly available specifications, does not trigger deemed export requirements. When a shared repository contains both controlled and non-controlled data, access must be provisioned at the file or subfolder level to exclude controlled items unless deemed export authorization has been obtained. Auto-provisioned full-access grants to mixed-content folders are prohibited for foreign-national staff without completed authorization.
